status.evidence: According to Companies House, Terramar Networks Limited is currently an active private limited company incorporated on 17 June 2009.

claims.claim: Marie Stopes International selected TerraMar Networks in 2016 as its partner for vehicle tracking and fleet management services, executing an incremental deployment of the company's tracpoint telematics software across country operations in more than 30 countries.

The company reports a strategic partnership with Toyota Gibraltar Stockholdings to deliver an integrated vehicle procurement and fleet management solution that enables tracking across both terrestrial cellular and satellite networks.

TerraMar Networks was awarded Teltonika Telematics Gold Partner status in 2026 for its performance, reflecting its capability to deploy telematics solutions via its Tracpoint platform using integrated Teltonika hardware.

The company maintains a public Privacy Policy, effective April 30, 2018, which establishes standard corporate guidelines for how user information is collected, utilized, and secured across its platforms.

TerraMar Networks Ltd was included as an approved supplier in a national framework agreement with ESPO initiated on May 15, 2017, valued at up to £40,000,000 for vehicle telematics provision to UK public sector organizations.
Unaudited abridged accounts prepared up to 31 December 2025 show that the company holds net assets of £1,087,887, according to corporate records available on Endole.
TerraMar Networks provided GPS vehicle tracking systems that were fitted to Quinn Therm's nineteen-strong fleet of trailers, as reported in Building Ireland magazine (Spring 2016).
claims.corrected: TerraMar Networks provided GPS vehicle tracking systems that were fitted to Quinn Therm's nineteen-strong fleet of trailers, as reported in Building Ireland magazine (Spring 2016).

claims.claim: TerraMar Networks operates a physical presence in the UK with a facility at City Factory, 100 Patrick Street in Derry, Northern Ireland, alongside a registered office in Cardiff, Wales, according to the company's privacy policy.
The company maintains an established local headcount of 11–50 employees within the United Kingdom, according to verification by the RevenueBase database.
